segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כָּשֵׁר בַּכֹּהֲנִים פָּסוּל בַּלְוִיִּם, כָּשֵׁר בַּלְוִיִּם פָּסוּל בַּכֹּהֲנִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» There is an element with which «priests» remain «fit» and «Levites are unfit,» and there is also an element with which «Levites» remain «fit» and «priests are unfit.»

moves.summary: states the paired contrast between priests and Levites, continuing the chapter's series of כשר ב… פסול ב… mishnayot
